raisedIn: Rego Park, Queens, New York City
background: Born and raised in Rego Park, Queens, in a Bukharian Jewish family; he shares a two-bedroom apartment with his parents, grandmother, and younger brother and often interprets Russian at appointments.
regionalHistory: His family left Dushanbe after the Soviet Union dissolved; Bukhori songs, Russian conversation, and memories of the old mahalla sit beside his unmistakably Queens childhood.
culturalBaseline: Traditional and observant at home, exploratory elsewhere; kosher practice and family customs matter even when he asks questions.
communicationStyle: Reserved at first, exact, quietly funny.
sensitivities: Bukharian Jews collapsed into Russian or Ashkenazi identity
interpreting for family mistaken for a lack of independence
